statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is composed of two distinct line items from the operating activities section of the cash flow statement: 'Depreciation and impairment of Equipment on operating leases, net' and 'Depreciation, amortization and impairment charges on Property, net'. These are the standard components for this field in the automotive industry. All other fields requested in the schema (e.g., total_operating_cost, taxes, interest_expenses, short_term_market_securities) were not present in the provided cash flow statement or supplementary notes. The supplementary note provided details on cash paid for taxes and interest, but these are cash payments, not the accrual-based expense figures that would map to the requested income statement fields. Therefore, only the depreciation_and_amortization field is populated.
